title: Who Am I Performing For?
headline: Are You Making Decisions for an Audience?
tagline: The need for approval often hides behind the desire to “keep everyone happy.”
seo_title: Are You Making Decisions for an Audience? A Mirror for Men | TheWrkShop
seo_description: The need for approval often hides behind the desire to keep everyone happy. A reflection, prayer and declaration for men who live for others' reactions.
verse_text: Am I now trying to win the approval of human beings, or of God?

scriptures.text: Am I now trying to win the approval of human beings, or of God?

items: What decisions were influenced by:
- fear of criticism,
- desire for approval,
- fear of disappointing someone?

blocks.text: If I wasn’t worried about their reaction…. would I make the same decision?
The need for approval often hides behind the desire to “keep everyone happy.”

items: Jesus,
Forgive me for the ways I seek approval from people more than faithfulness to You.
I confess how often I fear criticism, rejection, misunderstanding, and disappointment.
Help me anchor my identity in what You say about me.
Teach me to love people without being controlled by them.
Give me courage to stand firm when conviction and popularity collide.
You are the Way.
Help me follow You even when the crowd chooses another direction.
Amen.
I do not belong to the crowd.
I belong to Christ.
My identity is not determined by approval.
My worth is not determined by applause.
God’s opinion carries the greatest weight in my life.
I will not compromise conviction for acceptance.
Jesus is the Way.
And I will follow Him regardless of the crowd.
